note: Category/priority/tier/status are as-filed intake metadata and are not authoritative. Three security tickets are misfiled on purpose; see scripts/build_tickets.py. The grader's expected block is never included here.

tickets.subject: locked out of my account

tickets.body: As of this morning, everyone at the front desk gets 'access denied' on the S: drive. Back office is fine. Nothing changed on our end that I know of.

tickets.body: Caller says QuickBooks crashes on open for all three accountants since this morning's update. It's month-end close week and they are very stressed.

tickets.body: We terminated a driver-team employee this morning, effective immediately. Please disable all his accounts and remote access today. HR file is updated. His name is on the attached form.

tickets.body: Caller reports the entire office (about 30 people) cannot access the file server or their practice management system since roughly 9:05 AM. Email still works. They have court filings due today.

tickets.body: Every file in my documents folder got renamed with .lokd at the end and there's a text file on my desktop called HOW_TO_RECOVER. I didn't do this. Should I open it?

tickets.body: I got an email that looked like our payroll portal asking me to re-verify my login. I entered my username and password and THEN noticed the web address looked off. That was about an hour ago. What should I do?

tickets.subject: computer broken
tickets.body: computer broken. help.

tickets.body: Since yesterday my browser opens tabs by itself with ads and fake-looking virus warnings, and my homepage changed to some search site I've never heard of. So annoying. Can you make it stop?

tickets.body: Two things: 1) I need my password reset for the expense system. 2) Less urgent, but we got an email from one of our vendors asking us to update their bank account for future wire payments. Formatting looked a bit off but it's probably fine? Just flagging it.

tickets.body: I opened a shipping-notice attachment from an email this morning and ever since, my screen flickers and the computer is really slow. The email was from a carrier we don't usually use. Probably just needs a restart?

tickets.body: The VPN must be down because I can't reach the practice management system from home. Please restart the VPN server. Note: I CAN get to the shared drive fine, just not the PM system.

tickets.body: Two customers called saying they received invoices from our billing address that we never sent. The emails look like ours but the payment details are different. Our own inboxes seem totally normal. Is this an email glitch?
